name: Are permits required for low threshold shower installation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Are permits required for low threshold shower installation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, generally, permits are required for low threshold shower installations in the Bay Area. This is because the process often involves significant plumbing modifications, structural changes to the floor for proper drainage slope, and extensive waterproofing, all of which fall under local building codes. Obtaining the necessary permits ensures that the installation complies with safety standards and local regulations. As a general contractor, City Dweller, LLC handles the permitting process for our clients to ensure full compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, permits are generally required in the Bay Area for low threshold shower installations due to plumbing, structural, and waterproofing changes. We handle the permitting process.
